The structure of Ce₄Al₈Ni₄ (reduced formula CeAl₂Ni) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Al and Ni centers each with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Ce centers show 20 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Al-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Ce-centered 20-vertex polyhedra.
